high_level_description: The image shows a collection of skincare products, specifically face washes from the brand "Mamaearth." The products are neatly arranged on cardboard boxes, with some tubes lying flat and others standing upright. The face washes are labeled as "Vitamin C Face Wash" and are described as being "for skin illumination," indicating their purpose for brightening the skin. The packaging is predominantly white with green accents and features images of lemons and turmeric, suggesting that these ingredients are used in the product.
